section_103_gate_status_update.strongest_remaining_ksr_combination_atta: Primary: thrombectomy sensor-based automatic aspiration control (CN122376206A / EP3806757B1) + any motorized/servo catheter positioning system + general predictive control. Attack narrative: 'Combine known predictive-control architecture with known motorized-retraction actuator; choosing fragmentation-risk as controlled variable and pull velocity as manipulated variable is routine design choice.'
section_103_gate_status_update.candidate_strongest_defense: At complete causal loop level (CE-018): no cited reference closes the loop [sensed traction dynamics] → [forward prediction of fragmentation with quantified lead time] → [closed-loop traction-velocity modulation] → [verified embolization reduction]. Each element individually arguable as known; the specific coupling is an empirical physics claim. If physics is false, combination fails for inoperability; if true, question becomes whether it was obvious to test — resolved by wet-lab gate.
section_103_gate_status_update.strongest_alternative_explanation: Negative traction-velocity search may reflect terminology mismatch rather than genuine absence — the actuator IS taught somewhere under different vocabulary. This is why the adjacent-field check was executed; it returned clean.

physics_gate_design_adversarial.ceo_directive: The wet-lab design must test: fresh thrombus, different fibrin/RBC compositions, different clot lengths, realistic flow, curvature, device motion, traction velocities, aspiration pressures. Analysis must be blinded to fracture outcome during feature selection.

samples.material: Fresh porcine/bovine blood thrombus formed ex vivo within 24h; aged cohorts at 6h/24h/72h
samples.composition_matrix: RBC-rich (static stasis), fibrin-rich (Chandler loop flow-formed), mixed
samples.minimum_n: 10 clots per cell, 3 compositions × 3 ages = 90 clots minimum (power analysis before freezing protocol)
samples.negative_controls: Gelatin/agar phantoms (known non-fragmenting) to verify sensing chain does not produce false-positive fracture signatures

sensing.primary: Proximal axial force + displacement at traction actuator
sensing.confound_channel: Aspiration line pressure + flow (must be recorded to rule out alternative explanations)
sensing.ground_truth: High-speed optical imaging through transparent vessel mockup (fragmentation onset + embolic particle release)
sensing.tertiary: Acoustic emission (optional; must not dilute primary hypothesis)

conditions.flow: Pulsatile physiological flow (not static), including reduced-flow states
conditions.device_motion: Operator-style jiggle/advancement during traction, not pure axial pull
conditions.traction_velocities: Swept range from gentle manual withdrawal to aggressive pull; randomized order
conditions.design: Fractional factorial / response-surface design over {composition, length, curvature, velocity, vacuum}

physics_gate_design_adversarial.primary_endpoint: Lead time: interval between earliest statistically detectable change in traction-signal features and optically confirmed first fragmentation/embolic release
physics_gate_design_adversarial.success_threshold: Median lead time significantly >0 with lower confidence bound exceeding minimum actuator response latency. If lead time exists but shorter than achievable actuator response → mechanism is real but invention is inoperative — record as such.

blinding_protocol.feature_selection: Performed ONLY on development split whose fracture labels are sealed by independent party
blinding_protocol.feature_freezing: Features frozen in writing before label unsealing; then evaluated on held-out split
blinding_protocol.trial_randomization: All trials randomized and interleaved so experimenter cannot infer condition ordering
blinding_protocol.ground_truth_scoring: Two blinded reviewers from video; disagreements adjudicated by third

six_pre_registered_kill_conditions.K1_no_signal: No traction-signal feature shows change preceding fragmentation beyond chance (permutation test p>0.05 after correction) — predictive signal does not exist
six_pre_registered_kill_conditions.K2_not_robust: Signal exists only in idealized conditions and vanishes under realistic flow/curvature/motion — not robust
six_pre_registered_kill_conditions.K3_too_short: Lead time shorter than physically achievable actuator response latency — unactionable
six_pre_registered_kill_conditions.K4_redundant: Signal fully explained by already-measured aspiration pressure/flow — redundant, no new measurement needed
six_pre_registered_kill_conditions.K5_wrong_lever: Fragmentation incidence dominated by composition/age factors unrelated to traction dynamics; conditioning on traction features does not reduce incidence — wrong causal lever
six_pre_registered_kill_conditions.K6_not_reproducible: Effect does not replicate across independent clot batches/operators — artifact

statistical_analysis_plan.primary: Survival-analysis style (time-to-event) comparing pre-fragmentation feature deviation against null via block permutation on trial ID; report effect size with CI
statistical_analysis_plan.multiple_comparisons: Pre-register small primary feature family; exploratory channels labeled as such
statistical_analysis_plan.mixed_effects_model: Clot batch and day as random effects to separate reproducibility from condition effects
statistical_analysis_plan.pre_registration: Document signed and timestamped before first trial; deviations logged explicitly
